items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: He and Johnny Dodds, huh, both?

ctx.x: Well Sidney Bashe was the clarinet player with them. With which? With the Eagle band. Oh yeah. That was his band. That's right.
He and Johnny Dodds, huh, both? They had a good line up. But tough music. No, he didn't know no music. I say it was strictly tongue, tongue-style.

That's right. Just what they could pick up. They made their own. In other words, they'd hear a piano copy there, and they'd go there and compose it to suit themselves. And they really made well with it too.
